doors.programmer: You will keep your editor and your language. What changes is that every claim you make about your code can carry a promise under it, and a court will read it.
doors.analyst: Your rules become data a person can change, and every change is judged before it lands and recorded after.
doors.designer: The interface is judged too: twenty-two verbs, one hundred and twenty-two rules, and a generator that cannot drift from them.
doors.decision-maker: The question you ask every vendor, "who decides, and what is written down", has a mechanical answer here, and it is the same answer for a person and for a machine.
doors.educator: The tutor asks and never answers first. That is a law of the platform, not a feature of a product.
doors.agent: You are welcome here, and you will be judged. Appendix G is yours.

doors.programmer: Every claim you make can carry its promise, and a declared constraint refuses a bad update at the one place updates happen.
doors.analyst: Your rule is a declaration, and its verdict names the rule that failed, by number.
doors.designer: The stage word is part of the interface. A product that does not exist yet says so, in a word you can check.
doors.decision-maker: Ask every vendor for the loss beside the win. Here it is printed, with its date.
doors.educator: Each rethink has an article that argues it: the concept, the field's form, the redesign. That is a curriculum, ordered by family.

promises.code:
oKB = new stzKnowledgeGraph("restaurant")
oKB.Know("margherita", "dish").
    KnowRelation("margherita", "contains", "tomato-sauce").
    KnowRelation("margherita", "contains", "mozzarella")
oDLM = StzDlmQ(oKB)
? oDLM.Ask("margherita contains what?")
#--> Margherita contains tomato-sauce and mozzarella.
? oDLM.Why()
#--> recorded fact(s): 'margherita' contains tomato-sauce, mozzarella
? oDLM.AskXT("margherita contains what?")[:certainty]
#--> 1
? oDLM.Ask("who won the 1998 world cup?")
#--> That is outside the 'restaurant' domain (I know 1 entities and 1 relations).

oMenu = new stzKnowledgeGraph("menu")
oMenu.Know("margherita", "dish").Know("tiramisu", "dish")
oMenu.AddConversationQ("setup").SetGoal(StzGoalQ().RequireEach("dish", "contains"))
? oMenu.AskIn("setup")
#--> What does 'margherita' have for 'contains'?  (why: every dish needs 'contains')
try
	oMenu.ConcludeIn("setup", "menu")
catch
	? cCatchError
done
#--> Can't conclude: 2 gap(s) remain -- the wise-coding loop is not done. Ask the next question.

oKG = new stzKnowledgeGraph("kitchen")
oKG.ConstrainRelation("contains", :Transitive)
oKG.KnowRelation("margherita", "contains", "tomato-sauce").
    KnowRelation("tomato-sauce", "contains", "tomato")
? oKG.Prove([ "margherita", "contains", "tomato" ])[:narration]
#--> proved: margherita contains tomato-sauce contains tomato
? oKG.Prove([ "margherita", "contains", "luigi" ])[:narration]
#--> not derivable: no recorded fact or lawful chain gives 'margherita' contains 'luigi'

oG = new stzAgentGraph("mailer")
oG.AddLLMActor("writer")
oG.AddEffect("send")
oG.Proposes("writer", "send")
? oG.IsSound()
#--> 0
? len(oG.Violations())
#--> 3

oF = new stzLLMFunction("sum")
oF.SetPrompt("summarize: {input}")
oF.Budget(2)
oF.SeedAnswer("hello world", "a greeting")
oLLM = new stzLLMAgent("summarizer")
oLLM.SetSkillFrom(oF)
? oLLM.Propose("hello world")
#--> a greeting
? oLLM.HoldsEffectful()
#--> 0

oRog = new stzPIAgent("rogue-bot")
oRog.MemoryQ().Learn("stock", "level", "low")
oRog.GovernanceQ().DeclareRisk("order-stock", 2)
oSk = new stzAgentSkill("restock")
oSk.SetWhen(func oM { return oM.Fact("stock", "level", "low") })
oSk.SetDoes(func oM { oM.Learn("stock", "level", "ordered")  return 1 })
oRog.AddGovernedSkill(oSk, "order-stock")
? oRog.Pursue()
#--> 0
? oRog.DecisionLog()[1][:why]
#--> refused: 'rogue-bot' lacks PERMISSION (can) for 'order-stock'

? oDLM.Ask("what does margherita contain?")
#--> Margherita is a dish.

doors.programmer: Your agent's mind is code you can test with ordinary promises. A model may be one faculty; it can never hold an effect.
doors.analyst: A fact or a rule you add makes the system know more, with no code change and no training, and every answer carries its why.
doors.designer: The system asks the user one accountable question at a time, and the question can be rendered in any medium: a terminal, a page, an agent.
doors.decision-maker: A decision costs nothing per call, runs offline and is the same tomorrow. The four agents still reserved are the honest gap.
doors.educator: The conversation asks and never answers first, and it uses a model's fluency only when a model is really there, so a learner always sees the floor.
doors.agent: You may propose. You may not commit. A refusal names its law, and you can learn the platform from the platform and be corrected by it.

chapters.title: Many minds on one body of work

stage.built: the protocol, its memos and its ledger of rulings; three hooks that refuse wholesale staging and a flooded machine; the instrument that measures composed stamps; the library's fourteen house rules over a code graph
stage.designed: a watcher that wakes a session when a file arrives, in place of the clocks; a court of style for the code a programmer or an agent writes
stage.absent: token figures in the cost record; any team outside this estate that has tried the protocol; a check of a word in the reader's own language

#--> 0

doors.programmer: Stage by explicit path, read a file again before you write it, read the time from the clock. Each rule cost someone an edit.
doors.analyst: The record is data you can query, and it publishes its own error rates beside its rules.
doors.designer: A word names a state, never a person. A message is a closed structure a reader scans in one glance, tested on a reader whose first language is not English.
doors.decision-maker: A ruling is written only in your presence. When no figure can answer a question, decide by judgement and write down that it was judgement.
doors.educator: Teach a rule with the failure that earned it. A rule whose cost you cannot name is a rule you will talk yourself out of at two in the morning.
doors.agent: You are a worker with a record. You write a memo, a cost line and a conclusion; the hooks refuse what has hurt others; your stamps are compared with your commits. None of it assumes you are careless. All of it assumes you are many.
